contact.heroLede: Crafted with passion, inspired by late-night café adventures, and made to brighten your day.
contact.storyHeading: From Late-Night Café Adventures to Your Favorite Cup
contact.storyQuote: “Every cup tells a story of curiosity, creativity, and a shared love for coffee. What started as two people chasing their perfect brew became BTK Coffee — and we’re excited to share that passion with you.”
contact.storyPara1: BTK Coffee was born out of a shared passion for coffee between two people who simply loved exploring different cafés every night. What began as a nightly adventure to discover new flavors soon turned into a dream of crafting our own unique blend.
contact.storyPara2: With countless cups and late-night experiments, we finally created an iced coffee recipe that perfectly matched our palate. After sharing it with friends and receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback, BTK Coffee was officially established.
contact.footerBlurb: A Filipino coffee shop built from a shared passion for exploring cafés and developing the perfect iced coffee.
contact.footerSmall: Orders placed through this site are requests. They are confirmed by BTK Coffee on Messenger.
